groups.name: mediator.notification
groups.description: Configuration properties for Kpring MediatR notification handling.

properties.name: mediator.notification.activate-exception-handling
properties.description: Whether to activate exception handling for notifications. When enabled, exceptions thrown by notification handlers will be caught and processed by registered NotificationExceptionHandler instances.

properties.name: mediator.notification.graceful-shutdown-per-child
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for each notification handler to complete during graceful shutdown. This ensures that all in-flight notifications are processed before the application shuts down.

properties.name: mediator.notification.graceful-best-effort-after-cancel
properties.description: Additional time to wait after cancellation during graceful shutdown. This provides a best-effort attempt to complete any remaining notification processing.
